headline: Approved $52,507.63 supplemental appropriation for the Fiscal Year 2027 Law Department budget.
summary: The money is raised from the Fiscal Year 2027 tax levy. It covers November Law Department expenses and upcoming legal costs, including legal services tied to the November 4, 2026 election.
decisions: Approved the $52,507.63 supplemental appropriation for the Fiscal Year 2027 Law Department budget, by roll call vote of six in favor, with one member absent.

plain_text:
1 
 
 
Medford City Council 
Medford, Massachusetts 
  
Special Meeting, November 2, 2026 
 
This meeting took place via Zoom. 
 
CALL TO ORDER 
 
President Zac Bears called the Special Meeting of the Medford City Council to order via Zoom. 
 
ROLL CALL 
 
Present: President Bears; Councilor Callahan; Councilor Leming; Councilor Mullane; Councilor 
Scarpelli, Councilor Tseng. Six members were present and One member was absent (Vice 
President Lazzaro. Also present: City Clerk Laurel Siegel. 
 
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE MAYOR 
 
26-142 
Supplemental Appropriation for the Fiscal Year 2027 - Law Department 
Submitted by Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn
2
3 
 
Motion made by Councilor Leming to approve, seconded by Councilor Mullane. Approved on a 
Roll Call Vote of Six in favor, One absent (Vice President Lazzaro). 
 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
Motion to adjourn made by Councilor Tseng, seconded by Councilor Callahan. Approved on a 
Roll Call Vote of Six in favor, One absent (Vice President Lazzaro). 
 
President Bears adjourned the meeting. 
 
A true copy, Attest. 
 
Laurel Siegel 
City Clerk
